say:5:1736603005:1.text: The sword's been my passion since childhood, yet I was constantly told it wasn't a woman's weapon.

say:6:1736603006:1.text: I never let their words get to me. Once I pick up my sword, they fall silent.
say:6:1736603006:1.source_cn: 但我举起剑，挥动它时，那些人就全都学会了闭嘴。

say:9:1736603009:1.text: So, I've been pushing myself even harder in training to prove him wrong. My parents don't mind, figuring I can keep thugs at bay.
